title: Tokyo cafe ordering starter
hookText: Practice polite drink ordering before scripted roleplay.

rows.speaker: tong
rows.primaryText: 今日はカフェで注文の流れを練習しよう。
rows.englishText: Let's practice the cafe ordering flow today.

rows.speaker: partner
rows.primaryText: アイスラテを一つお願いします。
rows.localExplanationText: お願いします = polite request

rows.speaker: player
rows.primaryText: 砂糖は少なめでお願いします。
rows.englishText: Please make it with less sugar.
rows.localExplanationText: 少なめ = on the lighter side
